Wrote `index.md` and cover.svg for the parent expedition.

The synthesis lands on the cross-cutting constraint the three children only hint at separately: the Saturday-dinner shortlist is severely narrowed (Rutz/Facil closed weekends, Tim Raue closed Sun–Mon), which forces the activity geography (Mitte loop everyone; Kreuzberg afternoon for Horváth; Neukölln + Klunkerkranich for Coda), with a Friday "Early Kolibri" loophole. Booking windows for Reichstag and Rutz both close in late February. Tech overlay is negative space — Berlin Design Week is the only real event on those dates. Open question flagged: Potsdam was excluded by the 30 km cap.
